rules.opening_comment_disagreement: Header says five-minute bar; operative constant is3
rules.range_construction: At session-open+3 minutes, aggregate previous3 minute high/low and current security close, then widen high/low by breakout fraction
rules.long_signal: ADX28-hour>20 and +DI>-DI and smoothed daily volatility predicate and latest price>widened opening high
rules.intended_short_signal: ADX28-hour>20 and -DI>+DI and smoothed daily volatility predicate and latest price<widened opening low
rules.volatility_smoothing_updates: Daily ATR/STD indicator updates;32 is derived by integer truncation of5*6.5, not32 hourly samples
rules.volatility_predicate: smoothedATR>price*.00275 OR smoothedSTD>price*.005; explicit smoother readiness gate absent in entrance method
rules.warmup: Manually request20 daily bars and update ADX,ATR,STD; this is not proof every downstream indicator has reached readiness
rules.risk_limit_caveat: Sizing denominator0.1*ATR is not actual fill-to-stop distance and excludes roundtrip costs; source does not enforce0.25% actual worst-case account risk
rules.psar_reset: One minute before regular session open
rules.psar_updates: Every second-data OnData callback despite PSARMin name
rules.psar_activation: Profit above.0003, PSAR on correct side and tighter than current stop; after enabled, readyPSAR replaces stop without an explicit monotonic-stop check at each later update
rules.trade_count_guard: After stop ticket fills, clear opening range and disable further entries for that day; code is a stop-fill guard, not an independently validated order-count guarantee

short_order_sign_bug.meaning: Cannot represent faithful short execution; correction is an explicitly new adaptation

rules.current_flattening: CurrentSymbol OnEndOfDay liquidates; pinned engine security event is10 minutes before scheduled session close (15:50 regular,12:50 at13:00 earlyclose)
rules.earliest_flattening: 2015 parameterless OnEndOfDay liquidates at engine algorithm event23:58 local, not session close; it cannot guarantee zero overnight or immediate fill

short_stop_sign_bug.meaning: A genuine short position requires positive buy-to-cover stop quantity; changing only the entry sign does not repair protection

quantconnect_orb.one_hour_fidelity: Not feasible: first60-minute opening candle is known at10:30, after original10:00 entrance deadline;3-minute range and secondPSAR/stop path cannot be recovered from1hOHLC

Size from actual stop distance+roundtripcost; fees/slippage per side, full spread once across roundtrip
ATR,EMA,noise/session samples use causal warmup and explicit prior-session boundaries
Short selling, borrowability, contract sizing, live spreads, news and firm rules require separate verification
Resample synchronized portfolio sessions, not IID trades across correlatedSPYQQQIWM

No source example, retrospective model or generic floor replay proves actual prop payout
